scope: Targeted primary technical references for pressure, lift, pumps, heat transport and gas composition. The lunar comparisons are calculations or proposed applications, not observations from these sources.

sources.title: Lift Equation
sources.reading: Complete substantive equation and explanation read.
sources.supports: Lift proportional to density and speed squared for a specified coefficient and area; coefficients depend on actual flow and geometry.
sources.limit: No certified lunar aircraft, cost or biological flight outcome.

sources.title: Propeller Thrust
sources.reading: Actuator-disk momentum and Bernoulli derivation, density, mass flow and pressure jump read; no blade-design analysis.
sources.supports: Ideal induced-power scaling at fixed thrust and disk area.
sources.limit: Blade profile power, tip effects, actual efficiency and control are excluded.

sources.title: Improving Fan System Performance: A Sourcebook for Industry
sources.reading: Selected text: system approach, conditioning-equipment resistance, fan-curve density corrections and glossary definitions of flow and density. Full 92-page text was accessible, but not read throughout or visually reviewed.
sources.supports: Density and actual volume flow must be included in fan selection; filters and heat exchangers add system resistance.
sources.limit: The matched-pressure calculation is derived here; no current industry-energy totals or equipment quotation are adopted from this historical guide.

sources.title: SR1-86(1992): Revised Supplementary Release on Saturation Properties of Ordinary Water Substance
sources.reading: Landing page and the intended seven-page PDF retrieved. PDF pages 2, 3 and 7 rendered and inspected: temperature scale, constants, vapor-pressure equation and Table 1 controls. The repository's existing water law matches the displayed coefficients; its other thermodynamic functions were not used.
sources.temporary_pdf: not kept: a temporary download during source reading
sources.supports: Pure-water equilibrium saturation and inversion for boiling temperature. Table 1 gives 101325 Pa at 373.1243 K.
sources.limit: No mixture boiling, local heat-transfer coefficient, pump design or sterilization performance.

sources.title: Centrifugal Pump Lexicon: Atmospheric pressure
sources.reading: Complete substantive entry and pressure table read.
sources.supports: Actual site absolute pressure enters head and NPSH calculations; average pressure is only a rough reference.
sources.limit: The extra lunar water-column height is derived from delta p divided by rho g; required pump margin, friction and gas effects remain unpriced.

sources.title: Vacuum Bagging
sources.reading: Primary manufacturer's indexed Q&A read, including atmospheric clamping, setup and material/mold limits; direct page checked for the mechanism. No complete manual or experimental-data audit.
sources.supports: Vacuum bagging uses atmospheric pressure to consolidate and clamp laminates; materials, resin content, cure and tooling determine the result.
sources.limit: No measurement at 1.2 atm and no assumption that 20% more pressure produces 20% stronger or cheaper material.

sources.title: Compressor Thermodynamics
sources.reading: Complete substantive indexed equation and derivation read, including pressure ratio and efficiency.
sources.supports: Ideal-gas isentropic compression work depends on inlet temperature and absolute pressure ratio. Reversible isothermal work is independently derived from the ideal-gas law.
sources.limit: Actual compressors are irreversible; no specific process price, gas-separation credit or full pneumatic-cycle gain.

sources.title: National Field Manual, 6.2.1.C Measurement: Dissolved oxygen
sources.reading: Indexed primary passage on oxygen partial pressure, temperature and dissolved solids read. Direct PDF request returned 403; full chapter not retrieved.
sources.supports: Oxygen equilibrium concentration depends on oxygen partial pressure rather than total pressure alone, and on temperature and salinity.
sources.limit: No lunar gas-transfer rate, ecosystem productivity or automatic 20% oxygen bonus.

sources.title: Effect of altitude on equipment insulation level
sources.reading: Complete substantive manufacturer FAQ read; attached correction graph not inspected.
sources.supports: Ambient conditions affect external air insulation; sealed internal insulation has a different boundary.
sources.limit: A possible higher-density electrical margin is identified qualitatively. No extrapolated voltage rating or lunar standards claim.

sources.title: JSC 29353D: Flammability Configuration Analysis for Spacecraft Applications
sources.reading: Targeted extracted text on PDF page 19 (printed page 13): oxygen and diluent partial pressure, the Shuttle/ISS comparison and the dependence on material and pressure/concentration combination. No full 60-page handbook or hardware qualification review.
sources.supports: Oxygen partial pressure alone does not determine material flammability; nitrogen dilution can change the comparison.
sources.limit: No universal lunar flame-suppression factor, current material certification, or relaxation of the project fire analysis.

sources.title: The combined effect of pressure and oxygen concentration on piloted ignition of a solid combustible
sources.reading: Complete primary author/agency abstract and bibliographic record read. Full paper not read.
sources.supports: PMMA ignition experiments included constant-oxygen-partial-pressure mixtures and found nonmonotonic ignition delay as pressure decreased, with transport and chemical regimes.
sources.limit: Sub-atmospheric PMMA experiment; no 1.2-atm lunar material test, universal fire trend or fire-loss valuation.
